results.title: NOIA – “As Per My Last Email”
results.description: "As per my last email" is just an absolute nightmare phrase, a thing that you hate to see. It's also the title of NOIA's new single, a skittering, thumping, glitched-out avant-club track about the neverending always-online hell of office-job life in our corroded present. With digital effects chopping her voice into shards, NOIA repeats a few phrases again and again: "As per my last email, I haven't been able to focus," "I’m available all night, all day, every day." The post NOIA – “As Per My Last Email” appeared first on Stereogum .
